* '''PC-E2''' ([[At Peace (V) (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-atpeace-pre.gif]]): “Deploy on Dagobah: Yoda's Hut{{!}}Yoda's Hut. '''Date:''' placed at its server upload date, 25 February 2013, when the Players Committee server received the Virtual Block 1–7 card images. '''Document:''' Players Committee card image; slip number “2 • 22” bottom right, as on the release-sheet slip, the Virtual Block 6 set mark, the whole card with the Decipher art.
